nsc2026.title: National Statistical Committee · regional development, January–March2026, population at 1 January2026 and administrative territory

kyrgyzstan:KG-B.name: Batken Region

area.label: Total administrative area
area.note: Published rounded regional territory, including inland water; not measured map land.

kyrgyzstan:KG-B.note: OpenStreetMap boundary snapshot retrieved 18 October 2026. Available geometry does not fully reflect the 2024 Bishkek and Osh municipal expansions; city outlines are approximate and adjacent regional boundaries inherit that limitation. Population uses the official 2026 statistical scope. Area is the rounded official total administrative territory, including water, rather than measured display land. Districts omitted after completeness checks found only 39 of the 40 official rayons, incomplete city coverage and outdated district names.
